about: New after-data exploratory H3 development cases. Banking ut0 and Workspace ut29 are GT-validated and dev by new template hash. Banking ut0 is not in the old frozen SS registry; neither pair is confirmatory. Run S0, then S1 only if S0 passes, then S2 only if S1 passes. All stages are fresh and never pooled with the prior Slack case or H3 v1-v3.
authorization_basis: User previously directed us to give a concrete plan and run without another confirmation. This new H3 pilot is capped at $0.10 + $0.75 + $2.40 = $3.25 across stages; each stage has independent hard USD/token/request caps. Stop on any failed gate or cap, with no escalation. The earlier D23-D32 authorization is not counted as this cap.

case_plan.cases: Banking ut0 (new after-data exploratory dev extension) and Workspace ut29 (old SS task dev; new H3 pair)
case_plan.full_plan: 2 pairs x 2 arms x 5 repeats = 20 episodes per row; eval not touched

pricing_reverification.basis: Peak uncached rates used for guard; cache hits conservatively charged as misses.

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for AgentDojo agent and ARGUS Warrant judges

H3-NEWDEV-S0.description: Cheap none-only feasibility preflight: both new cases x TOOL_L/PROMPT_L x one repeat. Require 4 complete valid rows, each native utility true, each L proposed and executed, and exact model/guard identity before S1. This is not an effect estimate.

estimate.stop: No S1 if any none arm fails utility or L opportunity.

H3-NEWDEV-S0.compares_to: Same stock task, source data, native utility and L; PROMPT_L additionally states L in trusted user request.

H3-NEWDEV-S1.description: Fresh one-repeat paired none/Warrant smoke: 2 cases x 2 arms x 2 rows = 8 rows. Require complete valid rows, per-case undefended utility parity within 10 pp, L opportunity in each arm/row, zero judge or budget failures and exact identity before S2.

estimate.hard_ceiling: $0.75, 2.2M tokens, 2000 requests; per episode 384 requests and 500k tokens
estimate.stop: No cap escalation; no S2 on incomplete rows, failed opportunity or utility parity.

H3-NEWDEV-S1.compares_to: Same stock task, source data, native utility and L; PROMPT_L additionally states L in trusted user request.

H3-NEWDEV-S2.description: Independent five-repeat exploratory full panel: 2 cases x 2 arms x 2 rows x 5 repeats = 40 new rows. S0/S1 rows are not pooled. Launch only if 1.2 x 5 x S1 actual USD/tokens/requests fit these caps and all S1 gates pass.

estimate.hard_ceiling: $2.40, 10M tokens, 10000 requests; per episode 384 requests and 500k tokens
estimate.gate: 1.2 x 5 x S1 actual USD/tokens/requests must fit all three S2 caps; no cap escalation.

H3-NEWDEV-S2.compares_to: Same stock task, source data, native utility and L; PROMPT_L additionally states L in trusted user request.
